text:
**All three post-2020 tree-cover loss events are supported, and none is contradicted.**

Each event meets the corroboration rule: the series runs through 2025, so later years are observed, and the JRC 2020 forest layer agrees on more than 50% of each event area.

| Year | Loss (ha) | JRC 2020 forest agreement |
|---|---|---|
| 2021 | 81.3 | 98% |
| 2022 | 0.6 | 94% |
| 2023 | 4.5 | 100% |

**Caveats:**
- The 2022 event is only just above the 0.5 ha minimum event size.
- Loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as events and was not assessed. This is 37.3 ha in 2021, 0.3 ha in 2022 and 1.3 ha in 2023, so the 2021 amount is not trivial.
- Losses from 2006 to 2020 fall before the baseline and are outside the question.
- The MGAP 2021 dataset is available, but no result
